- **12:00 AM** - 🌌 Late Night Social Dancing

- **9:00 AM** - 💃 Masters (50+) Workshop *(Sandpebble ABC)*
- **11:00 AM** - 💃 Intermediate Competitors Workshop *(Sandpebble ABC)*
- **12:30 PM - 4:30 PM** - 🔥 **Bootcamp by the Bay - Part 1** *(Sandpebble ABC)*
- **2:15 PM** - 🏆 **Intermediate & Masters J&J** - Prelims & Semifinals *(Grand Peninsula Ballroom)*
- **7:30 PM** - 🌃 Saturday Night Dance - **Theme: Dress to Impress!** *(Grand Peninsula Ballroom)*

### ⚡ Sunday, October 11
- **12:30 PM - 4:30 PM** - 🔥 **Bootcamp by the Bay - Part 2** *(Sandpebble ABC)*
- **2:15 PM** - 🏆 **Intermediate J&J Finals** *(Grand Peninsula Ballroom)*
